stories.title: Nvidia earnings takeaways: Huang forecasts 70% fiscal 2028 revenue growth, far above estimates
stories.reason: Revenue of $96.2 billion beat estimates by $4.3 billion and Q3 guidance of $108 billion sent shares up 4%, a result that sets the tone for the entire AI trade.

stories.title: SpaceX plans to build the 'biggest launch site on Earth' for $100 billion in Louisiana
stories.reason: A 125,000-acre site enabling 30+ Starship flights a day would make Louisiana the busiest rocket launch hub on the planet, with construction starting in 2027.

stories.title: Judge clears the way for Postal Service work on Trump's mail-in voting order for now
stories.reason: A Boston federal judge canceled her own nationwide block on USPS following Supreme Court guidance, though the underlying legality of Trump's order is still unresolved.

stories.title: Nasdaq futures rise on bullish Nvidia sales growth
stories.reason: Salesforce jumped 13% and Okta over 20% on strong earnings, with Nvidia's guidance easing fears the AI spending boom was losing momentum.

stories.title: Underlying pace of inflation remained soft in July, giving Fed room for patience on hikes
stories.reason: Core PCE held steady at 3.3% year-over-year, the Fed's preferred inflation gauge, reinforcing Powell's Jackson Hole signal that a rate cut is on the table.
